main_library.notes: Reviewed the complete Transformers backend graph, processor, inference API, vLLM strategy, streaming convenience API, output parser, forced-aligner boundary, examples, and official supervised fine-tuning recipe. VoiceHub does not import or execute qwen_asr or Transformers.

architecture_reference.notes: VoiceHub reuses its independently implemented dense Qwen3 decoder after verifying the ASR model's identical-position multimodal RoPE reduces to ordinary temporal RoPE.

inference: three-stage convolutional audio frontend and chunk-length equation
bounded-window bidirectional audio Transformer and projector
dense Qwen3 decoder with grouped-query attention, Q/K normalization, RoPE, SwiGLU, and KV cache
Qwen2 byte-BPE tokenizer, official chat prompt, language protocol, hotword context, long-audio chunking, and repetition cleanup
strict single-file and sharded Safetensors inventory validation
training: raw PCM/tensor audio and text preparation
full differentiable backward through the audio tower, projector, and decoder
limitations: No corpus-level WER benchmark was run, so no accuracy improvement over the published checkpoints is claimed.
The official streaming helper buffers and reprocesses all accumulated audio with vLLM; the published graph has no incremental audio state and VoiceHub does not claim otherwise.
Timestamps require the separately published forced-aligner model and are not claimed by this ASR architecture.
CI executes graph, processor, checkpoint, generation, loss, backward, export, and reload tests on shape-reduced configurations; the exact public tensor inventories are validated separately.
